subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt five public memory role slots with per-agent overrides as the permanent plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: This changes public configuration, plugin hook APIs, activation, and session-scoped routing across core; technical correctness cannot establish the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Adopt role slots
options.body: Land after removing steady-state legacy reads, proving automatic upgrade migration, and refreshing final-head role-isolation evidence.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Ship fewer roles or global-only selection first, leaving per-agent and hook API expansion for an approved RFC follow-up.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Retain the existing single memory owner until the open RFC or another maintainer-sponsored design defines the permanent API.

recommendation.title: Adopt role slots
recommendation.body: Land after removing steady-state legacy reads, proving automatic upgrade migration, and refreshing final-head role-isolation evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the strongest ownership signal across the central plugin slot, loader, memory-state, and configuration contract files.
